command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "unknown"'); case "$model" in *Opus*) icon="◆";; *Haiku*) icon="·";; *) icon="◇";; esac; ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // empty'); if [ -n "$ctx" ]; then pct=$(printf '%.0f' "$ctx"); filled=$(( pct / 10 )); [ "$filled" -gt 10 ] && filled=10; empty=$(( 10 - filled )); bar=""; i=0; while [ $i -lt $filled ]; do bar="${bar}▓"; i=$((i+1)); done; i=0; while [ $i -lt $empty ]; do bar="${bar}░"; i=$((i+1)); done; if [ "$pct" -ge 90 ]; then color="\033[31m"; elif [ "$pct" -ge 75 ]; then color="\033[33m"; else color="\033[32m"; fi; ctx_part=$(printf "${color}%s %d%%\033[0m" "$bar" "$pct"); else ctx_part=""; fi; out="$icon $model"; [ -n "$ctx_part" ] && out="$out $ctx_part"; [ -n "$cost" ] && out="$out $(printf '$%.2f' "$cost")"; printf "%b\n" "$out"
